(3)
(a) Every office bearer of the Board including the
patrons  and  advisers,  shall  be  appointed  or
elected for a period of three years and any such
office bearer, patron or advisor shall be eligible
for re-appointment or re-election after the lapse
of the said period of three years for a further
period of three years ;

(b)
In the event of a vacancy occuring due to death,
resignation, incapacity or removal from office
of  an  office  bearer,  the  Board  shall,  having
regard to the rules of the body corporate, elect
or appoint a person to fill such vacancy ;
